newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer still hopeful on Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Placer still hopeful on Bre-X.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Wednesday it still hoped to be allowed to partner Bre-X Minerals Ltd in the development of the giant Busang gold field in Indonesia after news that Barrick Gold Corp was still seeking to finalize a deal with Bre-X.
The Indonesian government told Bre-X last week to negotiate a deal to give control of Busang to Barrick by today but the two companies said several points were unresolved.
"We're not discouraged. It's going to be a long process. I don't think today's deadline had any great signficance," Placer spokesman Hugh Leggatt said.
Placer had no response yet from the Indonesian government to its letter asking to be allowed to make a competing offer for Bre-X, he said.
